source: HAR captures of the official Slack web client, 2026-07-30, rands-leadership.slack.com (~10k users). Raw HARs are NOT committed: they contain live xoxc/xoxd credentials and message content.
purpose: Phase 2 (bootstrap rewrite) API contracts. Request params are verbatim with tokens redacted; response bodies are reduced to type/shape summaries so no message content is included.

edge:channels/info.note: check_membership:true does NOT add is_member to the result objects (0 of 36 observed results carry it). It adds the top-level member_channels array, which is returned even when results is empty - all 5 observed responses carrying member_channels had results:[]. failed_ids lists ids the server could not resolve; absence from results otherwise means "unchanged", so ignoring failed_ids would mark a failed id fresh and keep its stale record forever.

request_params.filter: everyone AND NOT bots AND NOT apps

captures_analyzed.note: All measured/* aggregates in this file cover all of these captures. The samples/* lists are capped at 3 per endpoint, so the distinct capture names appearing under samples are a subset.
